technique_name: What are the steps to design a digital customer experience?
description: The steps in designing a digital customer experience include: gathering customer feedback, understanding the customer journey, setting measurable goals, creating the customer experience, testing and refining the design, and launching the experience. Gathering customer feedback involves getting customer feedback on the existing user experience, including what works and what needs to be improved.
